top_signals.title: UNIFIL’s final months: Uncertainty persists in Lebanon over what comes next
top_signals.summary: The mission for the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon is nearing its end. Amid Israeli occupation, a decision on what comes next has yet to be made.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Modi’s party loses key India by-election in wake of protests
